confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence: sources are crowd-sourced or model-based and disagree by a meaningful margin, and the Tainan-specific figures were mostly drawn from cost-of-living databases. Beer and cappuccino agree closely across sources. Cocktail rests on Taipei venue and city-average figures adjusted down for Tainan. Wine_glass was not directly observed; it is set from the local beer relationship (about 2.3x beer), not from a glass-price source. Accommodation anchors (dorm, private, 1-star, 3-star) are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Tainan context, with low confidence. No live booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation (0.6720 for 2026-11-18) came from a secondary page citing RBA data; the rba.gov.au page itself was not opened to confirm the figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taiwan price levels, anchored to published Taipei and Taichung restaurant, café and beer figures, then adjusted down for Tainan as a smaller southern city. Cocktail and wine use Taipei bar listings and the local beer relationship. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for Tainan's guesthouse, hostel and mid-range hotel stock, not a comparison to a specific city.
